tests.title: parses planes with integer expressions and ranges and refuses shortest, enable= and every other option
selects min where in <= threshold and max otherwise, with ties, into owned tight planes without mutating padded inputs
refuses size and format mismatches, layouts, budgets, malformed storage, settings, timestamps and cancellation explicitly
plans the join on graph and timed paths, refuses linear chains, size mismatches, option errors and runtime commands
matches native split-from-one-source threshold on the graph path across every executable format, size, tie and plane mask
matches native split-from-one-source threshold CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the media backend graph path, with and without -ss/-t
matches native four-input threshold CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the stream path, ending with the shortest input, with and without -ss/-t
matches native threshold through createReplayVideoExecution with four distinct sources of unequal lengths and split graphs
matches native threshold through the timed backend on the actor and timed paths in rawvideo and framecrc, with unequal lengths
agrees with native under default threads and -filter_threads 1
refuses size mismatches and unsupported options that native refuses before opening any output on every path
negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses picks without frame storage by name before output on every join path

unsupported: 9- to 16-bit formats, yuv440p, yuv411p, yuv410p, yuvj*, yuva422p, yuva444p and gbrap (no frame storage; refused by name at negotiation)
packed RGB with alpha sources (native converts to gbrap; refused by name)
linear path (a join is never linear)

inputs with different frame rates: native keeps the first input's frame rate, the shared join clocks follow vf_stack; output diverges and cannot be refused from the descriptor (not claimed, not refused)
native exit status 234 (EINVAL) for size mismatches: EdgeFFmpeg refuses before output but exits 1

proposedContracts.name: matches native split-from-one-source threshold on the graph path across every executable format, size, tie and plane mask
proposedContracts.scope: six eight-bit formats x sizes 1x1..17x9 x six split graphs (ties, planes 15/1/5/0/10), compileVideoFilterGraph, 216 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: matches native split-from-one-source threshold CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the media backend graph path, with and without -ss/-t
proposedContracts.scope: media backend -filter_complex rawvideo and framecrc with and without -ss/-t, 216 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: matches native four-input threshold CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the stream path, ending with the shortest input, with and without -ss/-t
proposedContracts.scope: four distinct inputs at equal rates, unequal lengths end with the shortest, rawvideo/framecrc, -ss/-t, 240 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: matches native threshold through createReplayVideoExecution with four distinct sources of unequal lengths and split graphs
proposedContracts.scope: replay streams with bytes and timestamps, 40 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: matches native threshold through the timed backend on the actor and timed paths in rawvideo and framecrc, with unequal lengths
proposedContracts.scope: timed backend producer (actor) and pull (timed) schedulers, 120 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: agrees with native under default threads and -filter_threads 1
proposedContracts.scope: native slice-thread invariance, 12 comparisons. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: refuses size mismatches and unsupported options that native refuses before opening any output on every path
proposedContracts.scope: 8 refusals on graph/stream/actor/timed/linear with no output opened; EdgeFFmpeg status 1 vs native 234 for sizes. All platforms.

proposedContracts.name: negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses picks without frame storage by name before output on every join path
proposedContracts.scope: native picks from 14 storage sources on the four join paths, gbrap refused by name, 68 checks. All platforms.

sharedEditsNeeded: Frame rate for joins: VideoShape inputs to geometry() (or a join frame-rate hook) so threshold can keep the first input's frame rate as native config_output does, or refuse differing rates before output.
Exit status: map avfilter plan-time geometry errors to ExecutionError with AVERROR(EINVAL) (exit 234) in the media and timed backends to match native for size mismatches.
notes: tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts always drives the linear path, which a join never flags, so the per-source negotiation test reimplements the same check over graph/stream/actor/timed using negotiationSources from the helper (read-only).

Sandbox: Node 22.23.5 was installed; bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node 24.22.3 was downloaded (sha256-checked) and used for everything. Bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) took 212 s; the reference link did not match the linux-x64 pin, as expected for an unpinned sandbox build.
createReplayVideoExecution binds sources to external pads in order of appearance, so the replay graphs reference [0:v]..[3:v] in index order.
